verdict.rationale: Fireworks' pricing page explicitly says users can 'set a monthly spend limit to cap usage', which directly delivers a spending cap that bounds a runaway workload's bill. It also documents Auto Reload for a prepaid balance. The evidence is a single marketing-level line with no configuration docs or hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: documented budget/threshold alerts, detailed docs on how the spend limit is configured and enforced (e.g., hard cutoff behavior, per-project or per-key limits), independent corroboration.
